claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and titrate to improve respiratory acidosis (pH 7.25-7.27, pCO2 54-55).
Monitor arterial blood gases serially to assess the adequacy of ventilation and acid-base status.
Monitor continuous pulse oximetry and titrate supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 above the desaturation limit.
Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely given hypotension and tachycardia, with escalation of care if hypotension persists.
Obtain daily chest imaging if not already done to evaluate for pulmonary pathology contributing to hypercapnia.
Continue analgesia via PCA and epidural as prescribed, assessing pain and sedation levels regularly.
Monitor magnesium and potassium levels and replace electrolytes as needed, given prior hypomagnesemia and ongoing supplementation.
Assess and manage elevated intracranial pressure risk or neurologic status with regular neurologic checks.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with heparin or mechanical prophylaxis as ordered.
Maintain head-of-bed elevation and provide pulmonary hygiene (incentive spirometry, cough/deep breathing) to prevent atelectasis.
